stories.title: L’aéroport de Ryad reste fermé dimanche après une attaque ayant fait 12 morts et plus de 300 blessés

en.title: Riyadh airport remains closed Sunday after attack killing 12 and injuring over 300
en.summary: A missile struck Riyadh airport on Saturday afternoon, causing casualties with several injured in critical condition. Houthi forces threatened additional aerial attacks on Saudi Arabian air traffic on Sunday.

stories.title: Ukraine : Zelensky lâché par Trump pour récupérer du gazole russe

en.title: Ukraine: Zelensky abandoned by Trump to recover Russian diesel
en.summary: Trump criticized Ukrainian President Zelensky on Saturday, stating Ukraine needs new leadership to end the war with Russia, and claimed Putin seeks a conflict settlement.

stories.title: Approuvez-vous la décision de Trump de sceller un accord avec Poutine pour faire baisser les prix du diesel ?

en.title: Do you approve of Trump's decision to seal an agreement with Putin to lower diesel prices?
en.summary: Trump considers an agreement with Putin regarding diesel prices.

stories.title: "Il est temps pour l'Ukraine d'avoir un nouveau président" : Donald Trump appelle au remplacement de Volodymyr Zelensky pour parvenir "à un accord" avec la Russie

en.title: "It is time for Ukraine to have a new president": Donald Trump calls for Volodymyr Zelensky's replacement to reach "an agreement" with Russia
en.summary: Trump blamed Ukraine's leader for global diesel shortages caused by strikes on Russian refineries and called for his replacement to achieve a deal with Russia.

stories.title: Au moins douze morts et plus de 300 blessés dans une attaque contre l'aéroport de Riyad, la capitale de l'Arabie saoudite, imputée aux houthis

en.title: At least twelve dead and over 300 injured in attack on Riyadh airport, Saudi Arabia's capital, attributed to Houthis
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia killed at least twelve people and wounded over 300, marking the deadliest attack in the kingdom in more than a decade. The Houthis are blamed for the assault.

stories.title: Revanchard après les mondiaux, Paul Seixas s'offre le Tour de Lombardie

en.title: Eager for redemption after world championships, Paul Seixas wins the Tour of Lombardy
en.summary: French cyclist Paul Seixas won the Tour of Lombardy, the season's final Monument race, after disappointing performances at the world championships two weeks earlier. He also set the record as the race's youngest winner.

stories.title: Trump s’en prend à Zelensky et demande un nouveau président en Ukraine, la Russie acclame des propos «historiques»

en.title: Trump attacks Zelensky and calls for new Ukrainian president, Russia hails "historic" statements
en.summary: Trump criticized Ukraine's president and called for leadership change in the country, statements Russia characterized as historic. The British Prime Minister expressed solidarity with the Ukrainian president following a difficult period marked by a U.S.-Russia agreement on diesel.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : 12 morts et 309 blessés dans une attaque imputée aux Houthis contre l’aéroport de Riyad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: 12 dead and 309 injured in attack attributed to Houthis against Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack blamed on Houthis at Riyadh airport killed 12 people and injured 309, leading authorities to divert all flights and shift schools to remote learning. The Iran-aligned fighters threatened further strikes on Saudi airports.

stories.title: L'attaque contre l'aéroport de Riyad fait au moins 12 morts et plus de 300 blessés

en.title: Attack on Riyadh airport kills at least 12 and injures over 300
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia resulted in at least 12 deaths and 309 injuries on Saturday. The Saudi-led military coalition attributed responsibility to Yemen's Houthi group.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : 12 morts et plus de 300 blessés dans une attaque contre l’aéroport de Riyad, imputée aux houthistes

en.title: Saudi Arabia: 12 dead and over 300 injured in attack on Riyadh airport, attributed to Houthis
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people, including four Saudis and eight foreigners, and represents the deadliest such incident in the kingdom in over a decade.

stories.title: Donald Trump affirme qu’«il est temps pour l’Ukraine d’avoir un nouveau président» pour «parvenir à un accord» de paix avec la Russie

en.title: Donald Trump states that "it is time for Ukraine to have a new president" to "reach an agreement" of peace with Russia
en.summary: Donald Trump called for new Ukrainian leadership to achieve peace with Russia, with a Russian negotiator welcoming his statement. Trump reportedly reached an agreement with Vladimir Putin on diesel and urged Ukraine to stop attacking Russian refineries.

stories.title: Après l’accord entre Trump et Poutine sur le gazole, l’Europe entre consternation et soutien réaffirmé à l’Ukraine

en.title: After Trump-Putin agreement on diesel, Europe caught between dismay and reaffirmed support for Ukraine
en.summary: The U.S. president announced Friday that he negotiated massive deliveries of Russian diesel in exchange for lifting sanctions. European responses have been mixed regarding the agreement's implications for Ukraine's war effort.

stories.title: Portrait : Capitaine Florent, pilote de voltige à l’EVAAE

en.title: Profile: Captain Florent, aerobatic pilot at EVAAE
en.summary: A profile of Captain Florent, an aerobatic pilot, highlighting his passion for engines and achievements in international aerobatic competition.

stories.title: Au Brésil, Meta accusé d'interférer dans la présidentielle

en.title: In Brazil, Meta accused of interfering in presidential election
en.summary: Lula's campaign team filed a complaint against Meta, claiming the American company improperly restricted content distribution on Instagram during Brazil's presidential election.

stories.title: Des lycéens plus matures que ceux qui nous gouvernent. La chronique de Flora Ghebali

en.title: High school students more mature than those governing us. The column by Flora Ghebali
en.summary: Flora Ghebali argues that the high school student movement should not be reduced to violence or immature demands, but rather recognized for the maturity demonstrated by those participating in the mobilization.

stories.title: Certificats d'économies d'énergie : l'État resserre les contrôles

en.title: Energy savings certificates: the State tightens controls
en.summary: The government has published a decree strengthening oversight of energy savings certificate buyers and introducing stricter controls before their issuance, responding to market irregularities.

stories.title: OPINION. « Le recours dont nous avons besoin », par Jean-Luc Barré écrivain et historien

en.title: OPINION. "The recourse we need", by Jean-Luc Barré writer and historian
en.summary: Jean-Luc Barré, biographer of General de Gaulle and friend of Sébastien Lecornu, expresses belief in the current Prime Minister's presidential prospects.
